name: atv-azure-runtime-closure
description: Flat, reproducible runtime closure for the Azure SDKs that Next 16 + Turbopack's standalone tracer fails to bundle. Overlaid into .next/standalone/node_modules by the Dockerfile azure-deps stage. Top-level versions MUST match the root package.json; `overrides` force transitives that npm would otherwise float to the version pnpm resolved for the root build (keeps the runtime graph == the built/typechecked graph). Regenerate package-lock.json with `npm install --package-lock-only` in this dir on bump, then re-check transitives against pnpm-lock.yaml.
